facts.value: Students are required to complete three different lab sciences.

If lab sciences do not meet the requirement, additional information may be required from the student once their admission application reaches the evaluation team, which will be displayed as a Priority Task on My ASU called Course Description.

High schools can submit lab sciences to the courseapproval.asu.edu website for ASU to review if not already listed. Alternatively, students can submit a course description form for each lab science taken in an accredited online high school environment if not already approved.

Meet one of the following: two years of the same high school second language, attainment of a minimum score on a national standardized second language test, placement into a third semester college second language class based on university placement exam results, or two transferable 3- or 4-credit college-level courses in the same second language.
